page: Microsoft Azure DC2ads_v6 is an entry-tier general-purpose virtual machine running under Microsoft Hyper-V. It is provisioned with 2 vCPUs derived from a single dedicated physical core and two threads on an AMD EPYC 9V74 x86_64 processor. The configuration includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Memory is sized at 8.0 GB, yielding a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Attached local storage consists of an 81 GB SSD, and the instance supports Premium Storage configurations without included GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate a sharp divergence between single-threaded and parallel processing capability due to the single-core allocation. In stress-ng single-core tests, the instance scored 3015.55, ranking in the top 25 percent. Conversely, the overall multi-core metric registered in the bottom 25 percent. Geekbench results echo this pattern, achieving a single-core score of 1898.0 and text processing score of 2047.0 in the middle 50 percent, while the multi-core score of 2333.0 and image processing score of 1915.0 landed in the lower quartiles. PassMark metrics similarly placed CPU, memory, and database operations in lower tiers, alongside a Redis SET benchmark of 2.67 million operations per second.

From a resource and cost perspective, the DC2ads_v6 offers an economical entry point for lightweight applications that benefit from AMD Zen-based architectural instructions such as AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI. The key tradeoff lies in limited thread concurrency and memory capacity, which hinders heavy parallel computing and large data processing. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, CI/CD runner execution, microservices, development environments, and low-scale transactional databases that fit within modest memory bounds.
description: Microsoft Azure DC2ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V74 processor, it provides 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core with 2 threads, 32 MB of L3 cache, and 8.0 GB of system memory. Storage is handled by an integrated 81 GB local SSD alongside Premium Storage compatibility, with no dedicated GPU acceleration. In benchmark assessments, the system delivers strong single-core CPU execution, placing within the top 25 percent on stress-ng tests, while multi-core metrics and PassMark scores remain in the lower quartiles due to the dual-thread configuration. Instruction set support includes AVX-512 extensions and hardware-accelerated cryptography. Given its balanced resource distribution and dedicated core allocation, the DC2ads_v6 is suited for lightweight workloads such as microservices, staging environments, basic application hosting, and small utility tasks.
